assumptions: Local verification only; release sign-off does not deploy the application.

criteria.AC-001: GET /api/v1/stats/{code} for a live link includes Cache-Control directives private and no-store.
criteria.AC-002: HEAD /r/{code} preserves the redirect status and Location of a live link without incrementing its visit count. A subsequent GET still increments the count.
criteria.AC-003: The existing creation, resolution, reporting and expiry behaviors continue to pass their regression checks.
